version_message:
--- 0.4.1 Quick Fixes and Small Feature Additions ---

Fixed spaces in instance names breaking instance launching.

Added 'Last Used' sort option for servers and instances lists.

Fixed renaming an instance not updating the args.

Added a credits tab.



Description of main update [0.4.0]:

Made the Optimize Performance checkbox work properly across all mod loaders.

Added a new Profile tab where the username and skin settings/config now reside. Allows for multiple profiles.

Made Microsoft/online account profiles an option.

Added sorting/searching for the servers/instances lists.

Added the icon of the mod loader to the left of each server/instance.

Moved away from .mrpack to .altairpack format. Still backwards compatible with .mrpack, though.

Fixed the red line being misaligned in the skin placeholder image.

Made it so you can change your UUID (offline accounts only), plus you can view and copy your UUID for both online and offline accounts.

Replaced Extra JVM Args with Args to allow full control over the args used to start an instance/server.

Added a downgrade/upgrade button and menu in the Mod Manager to allow for mass upgrading or downgrading of mods.

Made the columns in the versions tab of the mod details window sortable.

If you experience any issues, please contact me and let me know. Please keep in mind that Altair is managed and developed by one person only (@kronos.solaris on Discord), so bugs are inevitable.
